currentBoundary.label: Runtime and model promotion
currentBoundary.summary: Released source and comparison evidence do not grant unreviewed model, acquisition, launchability, containment, or runtime authority.

releases.title: Publish model-aware context and completion budgets
releases.summary: Publishes model- and host-fit-aware context and completion budgets with authenticated discovery and exact prompt, transport, and response enforcement across supported serving routes.
releases.scope: Reviewed source and regression tests for supported fast-mlx routes; no universal model-family support, long-context quality, throughput, GLM runtime, deployment, or production promotion claim.

releases.title: Publish Qwen GDN launch evidence producer
releases.summary: Publishes a fail-closed Qwen3.8 live-exactness evidence producer that binds the committed harness, kernel-observed executable, process identity, GDN-on environment, and explicit dedicated-serving memory policy before model allocation.
releases.scope: Reviewed source and deterministic contract tests only; no live model exactness or performance result, host qualification, serving default, model promotion, deployment, or production authority.

releases.title: Bind Qwen scorecards to isolated GDN modes
releases.summary: Publishes a fail-closed Qwen performance scorecard contract that binds fusion mode, observed environment, launch identity, and process-isolation evidence before a fusion-enabled row can promote.
releases.scope: Reviewed source and synthetic contract tests only; no live Qwen3.8-27B exactness or performance result, host or model promotion, serving default, deployment, or production authority.

releases.title: Publish opt-in Qwen GDN projection fusion
releases.summary: Publishes a default-off four-input-projection fusion candidate for compatible quantized Qwen Gated DeltaNet layers, with storage-sharing checkpoint views and atomic lifecycle controls.
releases.scope: Reviewed source and synthetic parity tests only; no live Qwen3.8-27B performance result, serving default, model promotion, deployment, or production authority.

releases.title: Publish dedicated-serving qualification planning
releases.summary: Publishes a fail-closed, dry-run-only dedicated-serving qualification planner with explicit host evidence, staged ceiling candidates, and reconciled allocator budgets.
releases.scope: Planning source and tests only; no privilege, sysctl mutation, persistence, live host qualification, model load, runtime promotion, or deployment authority.

releases.title: Publish seeded sampled-MTP diagnostics
releases.summary: Publishes a caller-seeded, domain-separated sampled-MTP diagnostic provider with reproducible draw traces and transactional failure behavior.
releases.scope: Default-off source and tests only; no sampled-serving default, model runtime or loader support, Qwen3.8-27B exactness or performance claim, production promotion, or host authority.

releases.title: Publish current inference and capacity foundations
releases.summary: Publishes default-off sampled-MTP composition, adaptive serving controls, bounded Qwen3 MoE residency foundations, and auditable shared or dedicated capacity planning.
releases.scope: Source, tests, and fail-closed evidence only; no sampled-serving default, Qwen3.8-27B performance-parity claim, live MoE expert-streaming claim, model weights, production promotion, or host-mutation authority.

releases.title: Publish deterministic sampled-generation foundation
releases.summary: Publishes the deterministic CPU sampling oracle, exact contract tests, capability page, and technical note.
releases.scope: Internal deterministic CPU foundation only; no sampled HTTP/SSE serving, request/scheduler integration, MLX/model/tokenizer/automatic-entropy path, fusion, or performance claim.

releases.title: Publish self-reproducing public source
releases.summary: Publishes a sealed source projection that can re-export itself byte-for-byte with identical executable modes.
releases.scope: Reviewed public-source reproducibility only; no automatic intake or publication, external ingestion, new measurement, performance claim, runtime/model/acquisition authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish reviewed research Atom feed
releases.summary: Adds a deterministic text-only Atom feed for the seven reviewed fast-mlx research notes.
releases.scope: Reviewed research metadata and same-origin article discovery only; no article-body syndication, external ingestion, tracking, automatic-publication authority, new measurement, benchmark claim, runtime/model/acquisition authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish reviewed release detail permalinks
releases.summary: Adds immutable detail pages for each reviewed fast-mlx release checkpoint.
releases.scope: Static reviewed-release detail views only; no new measurement, ranking, recomputation, external ingestion, tracking, automatic-publication authority, runtime/model/acquisition authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish benchmark detail permalinks
releases.summary: Adds stable detail pages for the three reviewed fast-mlx benchmark highlights.
releases.scope: Immutable reviewed-result views only; no new measurement, ranking, recomputation, competitor comparison, runtime/model/acquisition/publication authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Show current reviewed cycle
releases.summary: Adds a manifest-derived home-page snapshot of the latest reviewed release, exact evidence inventory, and gated runtime/model boundary.
releases.scope: Static reviewed-manifest presentation only; no external ingestion, benchmark recomputation, tracking, publication authority, runtime/model promotion, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish reviewed social metadata
releases.summary: Adds exact self-canonical and Open Graph presentation metadata to the fourteen reviewed human-facing pages.
releases.scope: Presentation and crawl-discovery metadata only; no tracking, indexing guarantee, benchmark evidence, runtime authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish reviewed sitemap discovery
releases.summary: Publishes one deterministic sitemap and robots locator for the exact reviewed human-facing route set.
releases.scope: Crawl discovery only; no search submission, indexing guarantee, external ingestion, benchmark evidence, runtime authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish reviewed release Atom feed
releases.summary: Publishes a deterministic Atom 1.0 subscription feed derived only from the reviewed release ledger.
releases.scope: Static reviewed-release discoverability only; no external ingestion, benchmark evidence, runtime authority, or positive absorbed-MLA admission.

releases.title: Publish reviewed release ledger
releases.summary: Adds one generated human and machine-readable history of reviewed public milestones.
releases.scope: The ledger is discoverability metadata only; it creates no runtime, model, benchmark, or release authority.

releases.title: Publish reviewed benchmark explorer
releases.summary: Adds a no-recompute filterable view of the three reviewed fast-mlx performance highlights.
releases.scope: Filtering changes visibility only; every result retains its workload, date, decision, caveat, and evidence.

releases.title: Gate Pages deployment on public quality
releases.summary: Makes Pages a same-commit downstream job of the public-boundary and complete pure-Swift quality matrix.
releases.scope: This hardens deployment eligibility and provenance; it does not change inference behavior or grant runtime authority.

releases.title: Publish capabilities and evidence
releases.summary: Adds a status-aware capability inventory and a machine-readable contract for reviewed fast-mlx evidence.
releases.scope: Implemented, scoped-promoted, experimental, and shelved states remain distinct; source presence is not a support claim.

releases.title: Use compatible GitHub macOS runner
releases.summary: Selects a hosted macOS image that can parse the pinned Swift 6.3 dependency manifest and reports its toolchain.
releases.scope: This is a hosted-CI compatibility correction only; no application source or inference route changed.

releases.title: Initial public release
releases.summary: Establishes the history-free Apache-2.0 source projection and deterministic evidence-site sources.
releases.scope: The projection excludes private operator state, failed evidence, machine-local paths, models, caches, and benchmark roots.
